obligation: G003 / G015 — the non-trivial Noetic discriminator, and it returns a NEGATIVE
why_this_qualifies: its principal mechanism is not bit width, group size, local scalar quantization, PQ geometry, or linear basis sharing. It is a FOURTH-MOMENT statistic against a COORDINATE-PERMUTATION null -- a different question about the same organ.
statistic: centred participation of the ELEMENTWISE-SQUARED expert stack, against a per-row coordinate-permutation null, 5 draws, deficit_stderr_pct reported. LIVE requires deficit >= 2% AND > 2x the null's own stderr.
why_a_spectrum_cannot_see_it: a participation ratio is a second-moment statistic. Uncorrelated is not independent: rows can share a magnitude profile while their signs are independent, and the spectrum is blind to it by construction.
why_the_null_is_a_PERMUTATION_and_not_a_: the permutation independently reorders each energy row's coordinates, preserving EVERY marginal of that expert's magnitude histogram -- L2, kurtosis, sparsity -- and destroying only cross-expert coordinate alignment. A Gaussian matched only on energy-row-norms reports +7.8% 'sharing' on a sparse/dense mixture that the permutation null scores at -0.34%. THAT IS THE SAME DEFECT CLASS as the unmatched-norm linear null which licensed a 1.27% shared-structure claim on this very body.

nonlinear_not_linear.meaning: THE DECISIVE ONE. The spectrum MISSES it; the energy statistic CATCHES it. The probe adds something a spectrum cannot.

real_organ.independent_reproduction: the linear digits match G034_MOE_ANATOMY_NULL_CALIBRATED.json BIT-FOR-BIT -- participation 125.39, ratio 0.9796, deficit 0.002% -- so this lane reproduced my measurement with a different implementation before disagreeing with nothing.

verdict: NON-LINEAR SHARING IS ALSO DEAD on the honest test organ. The energy gap is RESOLVED (0.71% against a 0.0004 pp stderr, far above noise) and ECONOMICALLY NOTHING -- the same instrument scores +94.7% on the sign-magnitude control. Experts are as energy-independent as randomly aligned vectors carrying the same per-row magnitude histograms.
what_it_narrows: linear cross-expert sharing was already dead across six families. COORDINATE-ALIGNED FOURTH-MOMENT sharing is now dead on the organ that was the honest linear-null case. A joint description of these experts, if one exists, is not second-order and not fourth-order-coordinate-aligned. That is a publishable negative and it removes two whole classes.
still_open: representations that do not require coordinate alignment at all -- permutation/gauge alignment before sharing, router-conditioned reconstruction, procedural generation, activation-conditioned structure. This probe does not touch those.
